sn22.80:1.1: ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā sakkesu viharati kapilavatthusmiṃ nigrodhārāme.
sn22.80:1.2: atha kho bhagavā kismiñci deva pakaraṇe bhikkhusaṅghaṃ paṇāmetvā pubbaṇhasamayaṃ nivāsetvā pattacīvaramādāya kapilavatthuṃ piṇḍāya pāvisi
sn22.80:1.3: kapilavatthusmiṃ piṇḍāya caritvā pacchābhattaṃ piṇḍapātapaṭikkanto yena mahāvanaṃ tenupasaṅkami divāvihārāya
sn22.80:1.4: mahāvanaṃ ajjhogahetvā veluvalaṭṭhakāya mūle divāvihāraṃ nisīdi.
sn22.80:2.1: atha kho bhagavato rahogatassa paṭisallīnassa evaṃ cetaso parivitakko udapādi
sn22.80:2.3: santettha bhikkhū navā acirapabbajitā adhunāgatā imaṃ dhammavinayaṃ
sn22.80:2.4: tesaṃ mamaṃ apassantānaṃ siyā aññathattaṃ siyā vipariṇāmo
sn22.80:2.5: seyyathāpi nāma vacchassa taruṇassa mātaraṃ apassantassa siyā aññathattaṃ siyā vipariṇāmo
sn22.80:2.6: evameva santettha bhikkhū navā acirapabbajitā adhunāgatā imaṃ dhammavinayaṃ tesaṃ mamaṃ apassantānaṃ siyā aññathattaṃ siyā vipariṇāmo
sn22.80:2.7: seyyathāpi nāma bījānaṃ taruṇānaṃ udakaṃ alabhantānaṃ siyā aññathattaṃ siyā vipariṇāmo
sn22.80:2.8: evameva santettha bhikkhū navā acirapabbajitā adhunāgatā imaṃ dhammavinayaṃ
sn22.80:2.9: tesaṃ mamaṃ alabhantānaṃ dassanāya siyā aññathattaṃ siyā vipariṇāmo
sn22.80:2.10: yannūnāhaṃ yatheva mayā pubbe bhikkhusaṅgho anuggahito evameva etarahi anuggaṇheyyaṃ bhikkhusaṅghanti.
sn22.80:3.1: atha kho brahmā sahampati bhagavato cetasā cetoparivitakkamaññāya seyyathāpi nāma balavā puriso sammiñjitaṃ vā bāhaṃ pasāreyya pasāritaṃ vā bāhaṃ sammiñjeyya evameva brahmaloke antarahito bhagavato purato pāturahosi.
sn22.80:3.2: atha kho brahmā sahampati ekaṃsaṃ uttarāsaṅgaṃ karitvā yena bhagavā tenañjalimpaṇāmetvā bhagavantaṃ etadavoca
sn22.80:3.5: santettha bhikkhū navā acirapabbajitā adhunāgatā imaṃ dhammavinayaṃ
sn22.80:3.6: tesaṃ bhagavantaṃ apassantānaṃ siyā aññathattaṃ siyā vipariṇāmo
sn22.80:3.7: seyyathāpi nāma vacchassa taruṇassa mātaraṃ apassantassa siyā aññathattaṃ siyā vipariṇāmo
sn22.80:3.8: evameva santettha bhikkhū navā acirapabbajitā adhunāgatā imaṃ dhammavinayaṃ tesaṃ bhagavantaṃ apassantānaṃ siyā aññathattaṃ siyā vipariṇāmo
sn22.80:3.9: seyyathāpi nāma bījānaṃ taruṇānaṃ udakaṃ alabhantānaṃ siyā aññathattaṃ siyā vipariṇāmo
sn22.80:3.10: evameva santettha bhikkhū navā acirapabbajitā adhunāgatā imaṃ dhammavinayaṃ tesaṃ bhagavantaṃ alabhantānaṃ dassanāya siyā aññathattaṃ siyā vipariṇāmo
sn22.80:3.13: yatheva bhagavatā pubbe bhikkhusaṅgho anuggahito evameva etarahi anuggaṇhātu bhikkhusaṅghanti.
sn22.80:4.2: atha kho brahmā sahampati bhagavato adhivāsanaṃ viditvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā padakkhiṇaṃ katvā tatthevantaradhāyi.
sn22.80:5.1: atha kho bhagavā sāyaṇhasamayaṃ paṭisallāṇā vuṭṭhito yena nigrodhārāmo tenupasaṅkami upasaṅkamitvā paññatte āsane nisīdi.
sn22.80:5.2: nisajja kho bhagavā tathārūpaṃ iddhābhisaṅkhāraṃ abhisaṅkhāresi yathā te
sn22.80:5.3: bhikkhū ekadvīhikāya sārajjamānarūpā yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkamiṃsu upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdiṃsu. ekamantaṃ nisinne kho te bhikkhū bhagavā etadavoca
sn22.80:6.2: abhisāpoyaṃ bhikkhave lokasmiṃ piṇḍolo vicarasi pattapāṇi.
sn22.80:6.3: tañca kho etaṃ bhikkhave kulaputtā upenti atthavasikā atthavasaṃ paṭicca
sn22.80:6.4: neva rājābhinītā na corābhinītā na iṇaṭṭhā na bhayaṭṭhā na ājīvikāpakatā
sn22.80:6.5: apica kho otiṇṇāmha jātiyā jarāya maraṇena sokehi paridevehi dukkhehi domanassehi upāyāsehi dukkhotiṇṇā dukkhaparetā
sn22.80:6.6: appevanāma imassa kevalassa dukkhakkhandhassa antakiriyā paññāyethāti.
sn22.80:7.2: so ca hoti abhijjhālū kāmesu tibbasārāgo byāpannacitto paduṭṭhamanasaṅkappo muṭṭhassatī asampajāno asamāhito vibbhantacitto pākatindriyo.
sn22.80:7.3: seyyathāpi bhikkhave chavālātaṃ ubhato padittaṃ majjhe gūthagataṃ neva gāme kaṭṭhatthaṃ pharati nāraññe kaṭṭhatthaṃ pharati.
sn22.80:7.4: tathūpamāhaṃ bhikkhave imaṃ puggalaṃ vadāmi gihibhogā ca parihīno sāmaññatthaṃ ca na paripūreti.
sn22.80:8.3: ime ca kho bhikkhave tayo akusalavitakkā taṃ aparisesā nirujjhanti
sn22.80:8.4: catūsu vā satipaṭṭhānesu supatiṭṭhitacittassa viharato animittaṃ vā samādhiṃ bhāvayato.
sn22.80:8.5: yāvañcidaṃ bhikkhave alameva animitto samādhi bhāvetuṃ.
sn22.80:8.6: animitto bhikkhave samādhi bhāvito bahulīkato mahapphalo hoti mahānisaṃso.
sn22.80:9.3: tatra bhikkhave sutavā ariyasāvako iti paṭisañcikkhati
sn22.80:9.4: atthi nu kho taṃ kiñci lokasmiṃ yamahaṃ upādiyamāno navajjavā assanti.
sn22.80:9.6: natthi nu kho taṃ kiñci lokasmiṃ yamahaṃ upādiyamāno navajjavā assanti. so evaṃ pajānāti
sn22.80:9.7: ahañca rūpaññeva upādiyamāno upādiyeyyaṃ vedanaññeva upādiyamāno upādiyeyyaṃ
sn22.80:9.9: upādiyamāno upādiyeyyaṃ saṅkhāre yeva upādiyamāno upādiyeyyaṃ viññāṇaññeva upādiyamāno upādiyeyyaṃ
sn22.80:10.4: yaṃ panāniccaṃ dukkhaṃ vā taṃ sukhaṃ vāti.
sn22.80:10.6: yaṃ panāniccaṃ dukkhaṃ vipariṇāmadhammaṃ kallaṃ nu taṃ samanupassituṃ
sn22.80:10.7: etaṃ mama esohamasmi eso me attāti.
